added_failures_note: measured by this review: base arm b7d927c 392 passed EXIT=0, head arm 4c6e1f3d 416 passed EXIT=0, no failing id on either side

findings.summary: the docstring claims "a regression that adds the ends instead of subtracting them turns this control into the reference value and fails it", and that is false: the monkeypatch negates the upper antiderivative, so an add-the-ends assembly returns minus the reference (computed at r=1.35, z=0.4, gamma=-0.4: -2.3791789977911608e-07 against T=2.3791789977911608e-07), which the assertion at tests/test_edge_sheet.py:224 accepts. The control now exercises _pancake_flux's assembly as finding 8 asked, but it reddens on no regression of that assembly's two-ends difference.
the fragment repeats the same false claim, that an add-the-ends regression "returns the reference value and reddens this control", so the evidence document asserts a guard the test does not provide.

the 1259.9 ms "before" wall is quoted beside the 3.05 ms after-wall as though both came from the same measurement, but logs/closed-route-wall.log holds only the after arm (three post-change numbers, EXIT=0), so half of the before/after pair the done-when asks the fragment to record has no artefact a reader can open.

the fragment says the node closes "the five non-blocking findings of the closed-form field review and the blocking finding of the pancake review" (six), while the manifest claims all eight and the brief carries nine numbered items; the record understates what the node did and hides the route-flag, lazy-rule and edge-flip work from a reader of the landing record.

baseline_suite: and after_suite: are both empty, so the promoted run carries no gate arms at all and its added-failure count cannot be derived from its own record; this review had to run both arms itself (392 passed at b7d927c, 416 passed at 4c6e1f3d, delta 0).

the gate log's header records revision b7d927ce while the code it measured is the worktree that became 4c6e1f3d, so a reader cannot tie the 416-passed result to the commit being promoted from the log alone.
